title: Palindrome Ignoring Punctuation
description:
A line of text is a palindrome when, after removing every character that is not a letter or a digit and ignoring the difference between upper and lower case, it reads the same forwards and backwards. A line with no letters or digits at all counts as a palindrome.

Print YES if the line is a palindrome and NO otherwise.

Input format
One line of text.

Output format
YES or NO.
constraints: 1 <= length of the line <= 100000. The line contains printable ASCII characters.
hints: Spaces, punctuation and capital letters should not affect the answer. How could you build a cleaned copy of the line?
Keep only letters and digits, convert them to one case, then compare the cleaned text with its reverse.
Alternatively use two pointers from both ends, skipping characters that are not letters or digits, and compare the remaining characters in lower case.

examples.input: A man, a plan, a canal: Panama

examples.explanation: raceacar is not the same reversed.
